## ConfigParseError.path property

The path of the config file that failed to parse. This is `configDir` joined with `config.json` exactly as provided to `loadConfig` — it is not guaranteed to be absolute (`loadConfig` does not resolve a relative `configDir`<!-- -->).

**Signature:**

```typescript
readonly path: string;
```
